title: Strong enjoyment of driving the car
summary: Reviews in this topic express enthusiastic satisfaction with the car, especially its enjoyable driving experience and overall impressiveness.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car as excellent, lovely and impressive to drive, with owners saying they are very happy and thrilled with it.

limitations: The sample is small and all examples are positive fragments from the same model, country and engine type segment.

One fragment refers to trust in people having the reviewer's best interests at heart rather than the driving experience, so the topic includes some adjacent sentiment rather than one perfectly consistent aspect.
